request: Manual publication of three new GTA VI topics, nine complete versions, continuing the previous quality and1500–2500word scope per language.

execution.network: Inherited managed proxy and normal verified TLS; existing authorized connections only.
execution.scope: No purchases, new subscriptions, actual broadcasts, account changes or messages to third parties.

selection.decision: Three new guide intents compared with the complete catalogue and closest full existing texts; the existing announcements, clips and rights articles are linked, not duplicated or rewritten.

research.current_interest: Dated current EN/ES/FR coverage and task-specific search results. Qualitative signals only; no measured absolute volume or top-three ranking.
research.first_party_sources: The source ledger and review below contain canonical URLs, aliases, access evidence and conservative joint counts; failed, stale or unreadable menu pages were excluded from procedural claims.
research.copyright: No raw source bodies, assigned segment text or additional source-specific synopses committed. Guardian report and main VI landing page not used to manufacture extra topics.

visible_word_counts.method: Unicode words retaining apostrophes. Visible body paragraphs, H2/H3 and tables only; metadata, duplicated introduction alias, citation labels, alt and captions excluded.
